goal: A TelemetrySink protocol and a FileTelemetrySink implementation exist, writing one append-only JSONL file per run at <logs_root>/runs/<run_id>.jsonl with one flushed JSON object per line.

references: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/store_protocols.py -- mirror the existing Protocol + record-dataclass style for the sink protocol and its telemetry record type
constraints: Spec FR-1 and FR-2 are authoritative for the protocol surface and file layout; default logs root is .flywheel/logs

The protocol definition site must carry no file/JSON I/O imports beyond what store_protocols.py already allows; FileTelemetrySink lives in its own impure module, never in flywheel_core.task or flywheel_core.lifecycle
The telemetry record carries at minimum: kind, ts, attempt/iteration coordinates, and an opaque payload mapping
File write order is the canonical observability ordering; append-only, flush per line, no rewriting
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not wire the harness, stores, TUI, or audit module to the sink yet -- this task is the seam plus the file implementation only
edge_cases: Two concurrent runs must write disjoint files keyed by run_id
Creating the runs/ directory on first append must be idempotent and safe under concurrent sinks
